scope: Explicit atomic generation-aware author-side suggestion/revision/version custody, native delivery and recovery, original-family regressions and fresh public archives. Not permanent-observer generation transport, whole-room activation or release approval.

source.postQualificationChanges: Only this record, the retained guide's qualification/ownership/observer boundary notes and the V1 plan's scoped checkpoint note.

implementation.storage: A separately selected closed outer head saves the original native generation cut, relay metadata and unchanged original suggestion/revision/version records in one transaction. Existing entry points still refuse the new family; there is no automatic migration or separate retained-store database write.
implementation.admission: Private per-call ports require actual source custody, exact closed bindings and native packet/effect/owned-history checks. Detached recovery metadata, copied options and replacement storage callbacks cannot select the path.
implementation.pendingAndDurable: Every accepted queue change enters complete recoverable memory before asynchronous prerequisites. Confirmed records advance only after actual storage acknowledgement. Older physical attempts cannot roll current recoverable drafts backward; uncertain cuts reconcile before newer captures.
implementation.lifecycle: Component adoption precedes explicit connection. Close stops networking and native edits, then drains dependent stores before releasing the source. Failed final saves remain locally retriable after transport disposal. Repeated close/discard, temporary reservation refusal and opening/retirement races preserve custody and recovery.
implementation.ownership: The session owns adopted stores and stops its factory-created borrowed transports. Hosts dispose separately created views and SharedSuggestionSync consumers. Closed sessions release their retained record copies.
implementation.authority: Accepted content changes only through the original authenticated server decision order. Metadata and host-reacquired declarations grant no current account role, observer mode, provider authority, server activation or cross-device fencing. Credentials remain outside portable records.

tests.wireRequestCountReason: Coalesced asynchronous hint timing varies; stable results and all functional assertions are identical.
